📊01 · Daily Study Report

The day ends. The truth arrives.

Every night before you sleep, TrackUp asks the questions that matter — and an AI Review reads your whole day back to you in plain language, unlimited and free.

  • Instant Analysis — live count vs recorded count for lectures, daily tasks and Q's target, checked off one by one.
  • AI Review This Report — a natural-language read of your day's Internet(AI) data, no sign-up, no card, runs free on-device or via your own key.
  • No Backlog Day toggle — an honest flag for days you cleared everything pending.
  • Mood check-in — a five-face reflection so the report captures how the day actually felt, not just the numbers.
  • Auto-fill from logs — Study Log, Tasks and Syllabus feed the report automatically; you only fill what's missing.
🔥02 · Daily Grind

Six stages. Show up every day.

The Grind widget converts today's tasks and focus time into a stage you have to defend — Warm-Up all the way to Legend — visible on Home the second you open the app.

  • Stage ladder — Warm-Up → Momentum → Focus Zone → Deep Work → Beast Mode → Legend, each with its own hour target.
  • Blended % scoring — tasks done and focus hours both feed the same daily mission bar.
  • Live stage badge — see exactly which stage you're in and how far the next one is.
  • Editable stage hours — tune every stage's threshold to match your own routine from Settings.
  • Feeds XP & the report — grind progress rolls straight into your XP economy and tonight's report card.
🏆03 · Achievements & XP

46+ badges. Every grind gets a receipt.

Streaks, accuracy, syllabus mastery, focus hours and question counts each have their own achievement category — Streak Warriors, Accuracy Master, Practice Champion, Subject Specialist, Syllabus Slayer, Focus Grinder, XP Legend and Milestone Moments.

  • Four rarity tiers — Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary, each with its own unlock bar and %.
  • Live progress on locked badges — every locked achievement shows exactly how close you are, not just a padlock.
  • XP & Level system — every task, focus session and mastered chapter pays XP toward your next level.
  • Focus Medals — a separate ladder up to the 100th+ Focus session, unlocking one milestone at a time.

🎯04 · Reality Check & Milestones

Your exam date, doing the math for you.

Pin JEE Mains S1, S2, Advanced — or any custom date — and the Reality Check strip counts down every one of them at once, with a phase-by-phase breakdown of your prep.

  • Multiple live countdowns — Mains Session 1 & 2 and Advanced tracked side by side, hours-at-risk included.
  • Phase progress bars — Foundation Build-Up, Inter-Mains Consolidation, Ultimate Advanced Assault — each with its own score.
  • By-test-type breakdown — AFT, MFT, AITS, MastAdv and JEE-style series tracked separately under one milestone view.
  • Demotion risk warning — Level and XP show a live "at risk" flag if your pace drops.
✅05 · Tasks & Weekly Planner

Build the day before the day builds you.

Create a task straight from a syllabus chapter, attach subtasks per column, set a priority and a time — then let the Weekly Planner balance your whole week at a glance.

  • Chapter-linked subtasks — pick a chapter and column (Lecture, DPP, Revision...) and the subtask names itself.
  • Priority & time range — Low/Medium/High plus an optional start–end time, with a circular clock picker.
  • Repeat & "same task tomorrow" — one tap to carry recurring tasks forward instead of retyping them.
  • Weekly Planner — Week Summary and Day-wise Divide views with per-day topic goals and a backlog that never disappears quietly.
  • Sort by priority — the task list re-orders itself so the most urgent thing is always on top.
🗓️06 · Weekly Goals & Question Counter

A target for the week, not just the day.

Set a weekly topic goal per subject, and log every question you solve against a live weekly target — broken down by Physics, Chemistry, Maths and even lectures watched.

  • Weekly topic goals — "Master Electrostatics with a question target" pinned right under the week summary.
  • Live Qs counter — daily streak, weekly total and per-subject split, updating as you log.
  • JEE weightage reference — historical exam weightage (2019–25 avg) shown right next to the chapter you're logging.
  • Backlog — not done list — anything left behind from a past week surfaces automatically, nothing quietly vanishes.
📘07 · Syllabus Mastery

Every JEE chapter, tracked down to the column.

Physics, Chemistry and Maths broken into units, chapters and fully custom columns — Lecture, DPP, Revision, Class Notes, Modules, JM-PYQs, JA-PYQs, Rep. Sheets, Adv. Sheets — each with its own Done/Mastered toggle.

  • Fully custom columns — add your own column per subject (Coaching modules, test-series sheets, whatever you actually use).
  • Per-chapter deadlines — set one deadline that covers every column of a chapter at once.
  • JEE Main weightage — a real 2019–25 average weightage % shown against every chapter.
  • Topics, subtopics & JM/JA tags — drill down to individual topics, each independently tickable.
  • Quick Tests on this chapter — jump straight into a focused test from inside the chapter view.
  • Notes & attached resources — weak points, mistakes and Drive links pinned to the exact chapter they belong to.
🧪08 · Subject Branches & Manage Subjects

Chemistry isn't one subject. Treat it like three.

Split Chemistry into Physical / Inorganic / Organic (or any branch you want), give each subject its own colour, and control exactly which columns apply to every chapter at once.

  • Custom branches per subject — All / Physical / Inorganic / Organic tabs, so overall % never hides a weak branch.
  • PCM colours — pick the accent colour for Physics, Chemistry and Maths used everywhere in the app.
  • Chapter column defaults — set DPP and Revision targets once and apply them to every chapter in one go.
  • Global resources per branch — attach Drive links or modules once, available on every chapter below it.
⏱09 · Focus Timer & Flow State

Phone aside. Mind on the page.

Pick a subject, hit start, and the Flow State ring counts your deep-work session live — with break tracking, chronotype detection and a Focus Lock ladder that unlocks new milestones the longer you stay consistent.

  • Subject-linked sessions — Physics, Chemistry, Maths or a Mock Test, picked before the ring starts.
  • Break tracking — every pause is logged, not just hidden inside the total.
  • Linked task — pull today's next task straight from Weekly Planner into the timer.
  • Feeds Grind, XP and the report — every focused minute rolls into today's stage, XP and study report automatically.
🔒10 · Focus Milestones & Session Stats

The 100th Focus session is a badge. Earn it.

Every focus session counts toward a locked ladder — 3rd, 5th, 10th, all the way past the 100th — plus a full stats sidebar tracking your consistency and chronotype.

  • Locked milestone ladder — see every upcoming Focus Medal before you've earned it, not just the next one.
  • Days streak & 7-day average/peak — your real focus pattern, not just today's number.
  • Consistency % and average session length tracked automatically, week over week.
  • Chronotype detection — TrackUp learns whether you focus better morning or night from your own logged sessions.
🗂11 · Test Analytics

Find out exactly where the marks leak.

Log AITS, JEE Main and JEE Advanced-format tests with full custom categories, then let TrackUp auto-compute your subject-wise, chapter-wise and question-level performance.

  • Custom test categories — AITS, JEE Main, JEE Advanced, Mastery/Weekly and fully custom subtypes with your own column topics.
  • Upcoming test reminders — "Tomorrow", "In 3 days", "In 5 days" cards with a one-tap Log button.
  • Cumulative performance table — Physics, Chemistry, Maths and All Tests accuracy tracked across your entire season.
  • Full score entry — PCTLE, Rank, Time, Qs and Accuracy per section, with paper total and overall auto-computed from every section.
  • Chapter-wise auto-fill — questions asked in a test are picked straight from the syllabus you selected for it.
🎯12 · Quick Tests & Question Distribution

Test one chapter in sixty seconds.

Skip the full test flow — pick a subject, tick the chapters, set a question count and log the result on the spot, fully synced with per-chapter analysis.

  • Chapter-tap picker — tap chapters covered instead of typing a syllabus out by hand, full-syllabus option included.
  • Plan now, log later — leave the result blank while planning and fill it in once you've actually attempted it.
  • Correct / Incorrect / Skipped donut — a live question-distribution chart per subject, per test.
  • Chapter-wise questions & mistakes — every question logs straight into the Mistakes Notebook if you flag it.
📈12.6 · Trajectory & Unlock Criteria

See the climb, not just today's number.

Every locked achievement shows exactly what it takes to unlock it — hours, levels, report streaks — while Test Analytics quietly plots your whole season underneath, so progress always has a visible next step, not a mystery bar.

  • Exact unlock criteria — "100 hours of total focus time," "Reach XP Level 10," "Fill 30 Daily Study Reports" — spelled out on every locked badge.
  • Live progress bars — each locked achievement shows current/target and a % so far, not just a padlock.
  • Marks & Rank Trend — every test you log rolls into a live Physics/Chemistry/Maths marks trend and a rank trend, so one bad paper never gets to define the pattern.
🧠12.5 · Instant Test Analysis

Every test ends with a verdict, not just a score.

The moment a test is logged, Instant Analysis reads the whole paper back to you — rank, percentile, subject-wise accuracy, and exactly which subject cost you the most marks.

  • Score vs last test — accuracy, rank and percentile compared automatically against your previous attempt of the same type.
  • Subject accuracy breakdown — Physics, Chemistry, Maths each scored separately, weakest one called out first.
  • Plain-language verdict — "Physics is the weakest link this test at 68% accuracy — prioritise it first," not just a number.
  • Question Distribution per subject — Correct / Incorrect / Unattempted donuts for every subject, every test.
  • Share Test Result & Analysis — export the whole breakdown in one tap.
⚠️13 · Mistakes Notebook

A mistake repeated is a mistake untracked.

Every wrong question gets a subject, a chapter and a reason — Conceptual, Calculative, Silly Mistake or Formula — plus an optional photo or PDF of the actual question.

  • Four mistake types — fully custom-editable, so your notebook matches how you actually mess up.
  • Paste-the-question field — copy-paste straight from a PDF or website, no retyping.
  • Photo / PDF attachment — a screenshot or scan works too, right alongside the text.
  • Chapter Strength Record — every mistake rolls up into a per-chapter strength score you can review any time.
  • Linked mock test (optional) — tie a mistake back to the exact test it came from.

15 themes. Your arena, your colours.

Browse a full gallery of 15 hand-built themes, then go further — pick your own primary, secondary, background and card colours, and choose from multiple type families including a retro pixel font.

  • 15-theme gallery — PRO-Q Blue, Sunset, Neon Purple, Emerald, Crimson, Ocean, Gold and more, browsable in one tap.
  • Full custom colour control — primary, secondary, app background and card/box colour, independently.
  • Multiple font families — from clean defaults to "Press Start 2P" retro pixel type, in four sizes.

🖼️15 · Banners & Background Photos

Make the home screen genuinely yours.

Pick a banner style, drop in your own background photos, and let TrackUp rotate through them automatically — right down to the navigation style you tap all day.

  • Banner styles — Aurora, Sunset, Ocean, Graphite or Minimal, behind your countdown and streak.
  • Your own photos — add a personal album and set it as the app background, full-photo or gradient-blended.
  • Auto-rotate — set an interval and TrackUp cycles through your photos on its own.
  • Navigation style — Floating Compact, Classic Bar or Minimal — pick what fits your grip and your screen.
⚙️16 · Notebook, Backup & Total Control

Every setting you'd want, none you'd hide.

A live-synced Notebook mirrors your Mistakes Log and Syllabus Tracker as Excel-style grids, while Settings gives you granular control over notifications, offline mode, day rollover, focus auto-actions and full JSON backup.

  • Notebook — auto-fill Study Report in the background, plus live-synced Mistakes and Syllabus grids you can edit like a spreadsheet.
  • Smart notifications — test-day reminders, incomplete-task nudges, report-fill alerts, streak-break warnings, all individually toggleable.
  • Google Sign-In & Cloud Sync — one tap, no password, your data synced privately across every device you use.
  • Full backup & restore — export your entire history as JSON, restore it anywhere, plus automatic safety backups.
  • Offline mode & Day Rollover — keep working with no signal, and decide exactly when your study day ends.
